critical_code_review_comments: SupportButton.jsx:11 isMobile() checks navigator.userAgent against /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod|Mobile/i plus iPadOS fallback via maxTouchPoints>1 && /Macintosh/ - correctly handles iPadOS 13+ which reports Macintosh UA. OK.

SupportButton.jsx:13-17 openMail() only preventDefaults + sets window.location.href on mobile; desktop uses native <a target='_blank'> so the main CRMEvent tab is never replaced (new tab opens with mailto: which browser hands to mail client). Verified page.url unchanged after desktop click.

SupportButton.jsx:7-9 supportMailto() uses encodeURIComponent on subject and body, joins with ' - ' (en-dash) only when both org/name present (filter removes empties). Matches spec 'Supporto CRMEvent - [Org] - [Nome Cognome]'.
data-mode attribute ('email'|'video') enables stable e2e assertion without URL parsing. Good test hook.
rel='noopener noreferrer' on target='_blank' - security OK (tabnabbing protected).
Trial gating remains in Layout.jsx: during trial header-demo-button is shown and SupportButton not rendered - verified with QA gold trial account; no regression.
